title: Tag each intake finding
prompt: Place each finding in the risk area it belongs to.

pairs.item: Controlled-substance pages require both the pharmacist group and the clinic group.
pairs.why: An AND rule maps to a group intersection: a user must belong to every group within one entry.

pairs.item: Contractor accounts use personal emails that are not in SSO.
pairs.why: Unmatched identities need a manual map or a documented exclusion.

pairs.item: Permission removals must reach Glean within one hour.
pairs.why: Permission change frequency drives the refresh schedule.

pairs.item: No data may leave the customer network except to Glean indexing endpoints.
pairs.why: A self-hosted environment must allow pushes to Glean's indexing endpoints.

pairs.item: The source allows 300 requests per minute and returns 429 with Retry-After.
pairs.why: Pace below the quota and honor Retry-After.

pairs.item: Deletion tombstones are kept for only 30 days.
pairs.why: A short deletion signal means a regular full run must stay in the plan to reconcile deletions.

takeaway: Every finding lands in a design decision, or it was not worth asking.
